title: Markdown content
description: A Markdown Resource's body is a sidecar: a plain Markdown file with no frontmatter, beside its Resource file, owned by the Resource and written and removed with it (ADR 0128). Its path is <id>.md, named for the Resource's own id; the schema holds the shape and intake checks that the id is the Resource's, which gives every sidecar exactly one owner.

mediaType.description: text/markdown, in any case, since media types compare case-insensitively.
